versions.changelog: Everything is configured in the Jellyfin UI: series picker, Internet Archive commercials managed on the settings page and synced by a new scheduled task (replaces the Python builder), and run-now buttons.
First release: weekly Saturday Morning playlist with archive.org commercials (Jellyfin 12.1+).

name: Saturday Morning
description: Builds a weekly playlist of shuffled episodes from a chosen air-date range, one per series, with random vintage commercials (Internet Archive .strm files) between episodes.
overview: Saturday morning cartoons with vintage commercials.
